Create a photo of a 50-year-old Bulgarian woman on holiday in Istanbul. She has long blonde hair with soft natural waves past her shoulders, light tan, blue-grey eyes, light natural make-up, sunglasses pushed up on top of her head. She wears a loose white linen shirt with modest neckline buttoned to a normal height, small gold hoop earrings, a thin gold bracelet. She sits at a small table on the terrace of an ordinary rooftop café in Istanbul in the late afternoon; behind her, slightly out of focus but recognisable, the Bosphorus and a mosque with minarets on the skyline. On the table: a small tulip-shaped glass of red Turkish tea on a little saucer. Calm, warm, slightly dreamy expression with a soft smile, looking straight into the camera.

PHOTO STYLE (critical): it must look like a real, unedited photo taken with an ordinary smartphone camera (like an Instagram story or a selfie video still). Natural daylight, natural colours, real skin texture with pores and fine lines, slight phone-camera noise, normal phone depth of field. NOT glossy, NOT retouched, NOT cinematic, NOT a stock photo, NOT an advertising photo, no beauty filter, no studio lighting, no heavy background blur, no HDR look.
